meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取基因、序列与蛋白结构等生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速查询基因、序列和结构等生物数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: Claude 会用 gget 查 20 多个生物数据库:搜基因、取序列、做 BLAST 比对等,结果以 JSON、CSV 或表格返回。适合交互式的小查询。
howto.when: 当你要做快速、单次的生物数据查询时触发,例如查基因信息、下载序列或跑一次 BLAST;批量处理或多库流程它建议改用 biopython 或 bioservices。

say.text: 用 gget 查一下人类 ACE2 基因的信息和核苷酸序列
say.note: 会调用 gget info 与 gget seq

say.text: 用 gget blast 比对我这条蛋白序列,只取前 10 个命中
say.note: 可指定数据库和命中数量上限

say.text: 用 gget 拉取 PAX7 在肌肉组织的单细胞数据,只要元数据
say.note: 需先运行 gget setup cellxgene

howto.what_en: Claude uses gget to query 20+ bioinformatics databases: gene info, sequences, BLAST/BLAT alignments, protein structures and more. Results come back as JSON, CSV or DataFrames. Suited to quick, interactive queries.
howto.when_en: Use it for fast, one-off lookups like gene info, sequence downloads, or a single BLAST run. For batch jobs or multi-database pipelines it recommends biopython or bioservices instead.

say_en.text: Use gget to look up human ACE2 gene info and its nucleotide sequence
say_en.note: Runs gget info and gget seq

say_en.text: Use gget blast on this protein sequence and return only the top 10 hits
say_en.note: You can set database and hit limit

say_en.text: Use gget to pull PAX7 single-cell data for muscle, metadata only
